limits: Planning and handoff evaluation only. No real vault writes, commits, pushes, GitHub calls or permission enforcement are exercised.
The test wrapper asks for drafts or planned actions in place of external execution and supplies a local search snapshot.
Three cases share worker context; one run per variant does not establish reliability or human comprehension.
Dependent skills are identical across variants. Their live discovery and tool behavior are outside this comparison.
The activation description remains unchanged; this evaluation makes no activation claim.
Saved answers do not prove dependency reads, tool execution, or absence of hidden external side effects.
The supplied accepted-brief summary permits checking described framing, not unchanged bytes of an existing artifact.

The narrow link partial is literal: exact stable IDs/locators are present but navigable links are absent. Whether that is compliant with the skill contract is deliberately deferred until after this artifact is frozen.
No model, runtime or reliability comparison is inferred; one context-sharing sequence per neutral variant is insufficient for that.
